ok.feedback: 對！報告是「被交出去」的，所以要用被動 was submitted；時間是 yesterday，be 動詞用過去式 was。你抓到「主詞是物」這個線索了。
ok.reference_answer: The sales report was submitted to the manager yesterday.

wrong.feedback: 這句的主詞是 the sales report，報告不會自己交出去，是被交的，要用被動：was + submitted。只寫 submitted 會讓句子變成「報告自己交了」。
wrong.reference_answer: The sales report was submitted to the manager yesterday.
